definitions.explanation: One's name written by oneself, especially on documents for authentication or approval.
The act of adding one's signature to express support or agreement.

examples.japanese: ⟦ここ→ここ：00961_koko⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{署名|しょめい}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
{署名|しょめい}⟦{欄|らん}→欄：03901_ran⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}いた→書く：00477_kaku⟧。

examples.notes: {署名|しょめい}⟦{欄|らん}→欄：03901_ran⟧ = signature field/column

examples.english: Citizens demanded the enactment of a new law through a signature-gathering campaign.
examples.notes: {署名|しょめい}⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧ = signature-gathering activity

notes:
Used in formal contexts for signing official documents, petitions, and treaties.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{署名|しょめい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to sign)
・{署名|しょめい}⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧ (petition drive, signature campaign)
・{署名|しょめい}⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧ (signature-gathering activity)
・{署名|しょめい}⟦{欄|らん}→欄：03901_ran⟧ (signature field/column)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・⟦サイン→サイン：03846_sain⟧ is more casual and used for autographs from celebrities or informal signatures
・{署名|しょめい} is more formal, used for documents and petitions
